title: Graph Explorer
emptyFocus: Open an object from its detail view in the Graph Explorer (or double-tap a node) to start exploring its dependency graph.
truncated: Loaded {{kept}} of {{total}} reachable nodes — lower the depth or narrow the type filter to load them all.
truncatedMinDepth: Loaded the {{kept}} most-connected of {{total}} neighbors — narrow the type filter to load a complete slice.

toolbar.fullscreenTitle: Open in the full Graph Explorer

inspect.noNeighbors: No neighbors in the current graph.

filter.groupByFileHint: Group nodes into boxes per file

colorModeHints.recency: Colour nodes by the age of their newest individual change (the classes of the Graph Atlas)

filter.openDetails: Open the focus object’s detail view
filter.extendDepthHint: Extend the slider past 4 (up to the reachable max depth).
filter.loadAllHint: Load all types; deselecting a chip only hides it

typeList.empty: No objects of this type in the graph.

unconnectedHidden_one: {{count}} node not connected to the focus
unconnectedHidden_other: {{count}} nodes not connected to the focus
unconnectedToggleHint: Nodes with no path to the focus result from the type/depth filter — show or hide them

trace.exitHint: Leave the trace and open the neighborhood view of the start object
trace.explainer: Selective flow graph — the call chain up/down, the objects it actually touches, and the script triggers of entered layouts.

entryHints.layout_runtime: Triggers of the layout and its objects + button scripts as starting points

trace.upDepthHint: How many caller levels the chain is followed upward
trace.downDepthHint: How many subscript levels the chain is followed downward
trace.triggerDepthHint: How many cascade stages layout triggers may fire (0 = off)
trace.localVarsHint: Also show local $ variables of the chain scripts
trace.buttonsHint: Include button scripts of entered layouts as possible interactions
trace.interactionTriggersHint: Also let interaction events (keyboard, gestures, device buttons) fire in the cascade — they normally never fire during a script run
trace.expandUpHint: Also collect the objects touched by the caller chain
trace.emptyEntry: The chosen preset yields no seed scripts — please pick another entry path.
trace.truncated: {{kept}} of {{total}} trace nodes loaded — reduce the budgets to focus the excerpt.
trace.dynamicCalls: {{count}} dynamic script call (by name) without a static edge — the trace is a static approximation.
trace.dynamicCalls_other: {{count}} dynamic script calls (by name) without a static edge — the trace is a static approximation.
trace.actionHint: Open the flow graph (trace) from this object
trace.excludeHint: Keep the node visible but stop expanding through it (calls, touches, trigger cascade)
trace.clearExcludesHint: Remove all exclusions and fully re-expand the trace
trace.removeExcludeHint: Remove this exclusion — the node will be expanded again
trace.applyAllSuggestionsHint: Add all suggested hub nodes to the exclusion list
trace.suggestionHint: Suspected hub — trigger fan-in {{trig}}, callers {{calls}}, field touches {{touch}}. Click to exclude the node from the trace.

ways.entryChipHint: Show or hide layouts and samples
ways.diagramHint: Show the way as a Mermaid diagram
ways.diagramMissing: There is no diagram for this way.
ways.diagramError: The diagram could not be drawn
ways.copySourceHint: Copy the Mermaid source to the clipboard

flow.schemaDrift: The catalog of this solution is older than the flow trace — please re-import the solution.
flow.notBuilt: The dataflow tables the flow trace needs are missing — the dataflow phase failed during import (see the import log). Re-import the solution.

tab.downHint: What happens when the script runs — one way per reached script
tab.upHint: How the script is reached — one way per entry

flow.overviewDownHint: Script tree of all called scripts as a Mermaid diagram
flow.overviewUpHint: Entries → entry scripts → start as a Mermaid diagram
flow.noWaysDown: This script calls no other script within the limits.
flow.noWaysUp: No entry found within the limits.

flags.alwaysHint: No call on this way sits under a condition
flags.conditionsHint: Calls on this way whose call sites all sit under If / Else If / Else — the trace shows the condition, it does not evaluate it
flags.loopHint: A call on this way sits inside a loop
flags.serverHint: Runs on the server (Perform Script on Server) — server context from there on
flags.crossFileHint: The way crosses into another file
flags.paramHint: A call on this way passes a script parameter
flags.unreachableHint: A call on this way only sits after Exit Script / Halt Script in its block
flags.approxHint: A call without a step anchor (plugin call) — the edge is only approximately backed
flags.dynamicHint: The call step has no static target (by name or unresolved)

flow.effectsHint: Distinct objects the target script touches — expand for the objects in the graph

kindHint.cascade: Reached through a script trigger of a layout the way enters
kindHint.trigger: Script trigger of the start layout
kindHint.dynamic: Call step without a static target — the called script is unknown

blindKind.by_name: The script is chosen by name at run time
blindKind.unresolved: Neither target nor name formula — e.g. a script of a file outside the catalog

flow.openStepHint: Open the calling script at this step
flow.traceFromHereHint: Start a new trace at this script

entryKindHint.root: No script calls this script — it starts through its entries or by hand
entryKindHint.budget: The callers go on beyond the up budget — raise it in the trace panel
entryKindHint.excluded: Excluded in this trace (boundary) — its callers are not followed

flow.levelHint: Call levels between the entry script and the start
flow.followSourceHint: Follow this entry one level further: the scripts that enter its layout (Go to Layout), or the callers beyond the up budget
flow.followSourceNone: No further entries found — nothing enters the layout or calls beyond the budget outside the trace.
flow.searchPlaceholder: Find a script in the ways…
flow.searchNone: No loaded way leads to a script with this name.
flow.includeDisabledHint: Also follow calls, touches and navigation of disabled steps

stat.conditionalCallsHint: Call sites under If / Else If / Else
stat.dynamicCallsHint: Perform Script by name — the target is decided at run time (red diamond)
stat.unresolvedCallsHint: Call step with neither target nor name formula

flow.effectNoDdrHint: File without DDR info: fields read in formulas, parameters and results are missing from these effects.

data.title: Data flow
data.explainerUp: Origin of the field value — which steps, calculations and entries write it, and from where they are reached.
data.explainerDown: Usage of the field value — where it flows: read by steps, written on into fields, displayed, sorted, exported.
data.originHint: Where does the value of this field come from? (data trace)
data.usageHint: Where does the value of this field flow to? (data trace)
data.actionHint: Open the data trace: where the value of this field comes from and where it flows to (direction in the ways list)
data.actionHintVariable: Open the data trace: where the value of this variable comes from and where it flows to (direction in the ways list)
data.actionHintAnchored: Open the data trace from this step — the anchor can be removed in the trace panel
data.fieldLevelsHint: How many field-to-field transitions are followed (default 1 — go deeper per way with “Follow source”)
data.controlHint: Show fields and variables that only control (conditions, SQL filters, repetition) — as leaves, not followed further
data.resetHint: Show write steps with an empty value ("") as ways of their own instead of only in the “Reset” group
data.sinksHint: Count display, sort, export, find, relationship and value list as usage
data.profileHint: Apply the confirmed rules of the solution profile (technical layouts, infrastructure scripts, UI state and hub variables)
data.profileManageHint: See all candidates per heuristic and confirm or reject them in bulk
data.profileOff: Profile switched off — purely generic view

applied.uiStateVariable: {{count}} UI state variable treated as control
applied.uiStateVariable_other: {{count}} UI state variables treated as control
applied.hubReaders: {{count}} reader of hub variables only counted
applied.hubReaders_other: {{count}} readers of hub variables only counted

candidate.ui_state_variable: “{{name}}” looks like a UI state variable

heuristicHint.H1: H1 — at least 5 layouts of the same name, each showing at least 60 % of its table's fields editable
heuristicHint.H2: H2 — called from at least 5 files, result read at no call site
heuristicHint.H3: H3 — at least 80 % of the read sites are layout objects
heuristicHint.H4: H4 — at least 100 read contexts; below 50 % layout share only as uncertain

data.confirmHint: Add as a rule to the solution profile

truncatedBy.field_levels: Cut at the field level limit
truncatedBy.var_levels: Cut at the variable level limit
truncatedBy.step_limit: Cut at the step limit per path

blind.dynamicWritesHint: Set Field By Name, insert into the active field — the target field is statically unknown
blind.uninitialized: {{count}} variable without a setter in the script
blind.uninitialized_other: {{count}} variables without a setter in the script
blind.approxEdgesHint: Connected via custom functions, SQL without a position filter or several possible setters
blind.contextOpenHint: Parameter or result without a known call site — connected to every call site

data.levelHint: Field level — how many field-to-field transitions away from the start field
data.approxHint: At least one edge of the way is only approximately backed
data.noEntries: No entry found — callers are missing or lie outside the limits.
data.followSourceHint: Follow the source fields of this way one level further
data.flowTraceHint: Open the flow trace of this step's script
data.overviewHint: Field-to-field overview of all ways as a Mermaid diagram
data.noWaysUp: No write way found — the field is filled only by hand, by a formula without field references, or not at all.
data.resetGroupHint: Write steps that empty the field ("") — no ways of their own by default
data.profileDialogTitle: Solution profile of the data trace
data.profileDialogIntro: Suggestions from the catalog. Only confirmed rules apply; rejected candidates do not come back. The profile lives in the solution bundle and survives re-imports.
data.notBuilt: The dataflow tables are missing for this solution — the dataflow phase failed during the import (see the import log). Re-import the solution.
data.schemaDrift: The catalog of this solution is older than the data trace — please re-import the solution.
data.cutFieldLevels: {{count}} source field beyond the level limit — “Follow source” goes further per way
data.cutFieldLevels_other: {{count}} source fields beyond the level limit — “Follow source” goes further per way
data.usageGraphHidden: Usage is shown as the impact list on the right. The graph ({{count}} node) is on demand.
data.usageGraphHidden_other: Usage is shown as the impact list on the right. The graph ({{count}} nodes) is on demand.
data.originHintVariable: Where does the value of this variable come from? (data trace)
data.usageHintVariable: Where does the value of this variable flow to? (data trace)
data.explainerUpVariable: Origin of the variable value — which steps set the variable, where its value comes from and from where the setters are reached.
data.explainerDownVariable: Usage of the variable value — which steps read the variable, where the value flows on and where it is displayed.
data.clearAnchorHint: Remove the anchor: all setters or readers in the script
data.noDdrWayHint: The way touches a file without DDR info — fields read, parameters and results can be missing, the way can end early.

noDdr.title: Without DDR info
noDdr.notice: File without DDR info: {{files}}. Field references in formulas as well as script parameters and results are missing there — ways can end early.
noDdr.notice_other: Files without DDR info: {{files}}. Field references in formulas as well as script parameters and results are missing there — ways can end early.
noDdr.hint: Re-export with “Include details for analysis tools”, then re-import.
